title: pilosella roxolanica subsp. rehmannii
intro: Pilosella roxolanica subsp. rehmannii, commonly known as European bitter lettuce, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella roxolanica subsp. rehmannii include lowering blood pressure, reducing fever, and alleviating gastrointestinal issues. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
